# Environment variables

<!-- GENERATED by bin/gen_config_docs.py from the config registry. Do not edit. -->

m3's settings live in `m3_config.toml` ([reference](CONFIG_REFERENCE.md)) and its secrets in the user-only secrets file. The environment is left with three jobs: saying where m3's files are (the locators), a few switches and handoffs that are read before any configuration loads, and other programs' own variables. Every other name below is a **former name** of a setting: m3 does not read it (`m3_config.toml` has precedence, and a key it lacks takes its default). `m3 doctor`, `m3 setup` and `m3 upgrade` name each one still set and where, so you or your agent can delete it.

When the config root has no `m3_config.toml`, `m3 setup` and `m3 upgrade` create it from `default-m3_config.toml` and copy into it, once, the values set under these names in the environment, shell startup files, `.env` files, the Windows persistent environment, agents' MCP `env` blocks and m3's service definitions (secrets go to the secrets file). An existing file is never re-imported or overwritten; `m3 config import-env` copies on request. Neither edits the places it reads from; delete the old copies yourself. `m3 config show --origin` prints where each value came from.

- [Variables m3 reads by design](#variables-m3-reads-by-design)
- [Settings: environment name to config key](#settings-environment-name-to-config-key)
- [Secrets: environment name to secrets file](#secrets-environment-name-to-secrets-file)
- [Retired: no effect](#retired-no-effect)

## Variables m3 reads by design

### Roots and locators

A locator says where m3's files are, so it is read before any configuration loads. The file is `m3_config.toml` in the config root (`--config <file>` > `M3_CONFIG_ROOT` > `~/.m3/config`). Every other root comes from `[paths]` in that file. No locator is required; each has a working default.

| Name | Config key | What it locates |
|---|---|---|
| `M3_CONFIG_ROOT` | (none) | the config locator: it picks which m3_config.toml is read |
| `M3_PATH_ASSETS` | `[paths].assets` | The payload's _assets/ directory for a non-packaged install (installer.py _payload_dir); unset uses the packaged one. |
| `M3_PATH_BIN` | `[paths].bin` | The bin/ directory of a non-packaged (developer) install; unset uses the packaged one. |
| `M3_PATH_DOC` | `[paths].docs` | The payload's docs/ directory for a non-packaged install (installer.py _payload_dir); unset uses the packaged one. |
| `M3_ENGINE_ROOT` | `[paths].engine_root` | Databases and runtime state. Default: &lt;memory_root>/engine, else ~/.m3/engine. |
| `M3_PATH_EXAMPLES` | `[paths].examples` | The payload's examples/ directory for a non-packaged install (installer.py _payload_dir); unset uses the packaged one. |
| `M3_LIB_DIR` | `[paths].lib_dir` | Where the wolfSSL library is trusted from. Default: &lt;config root's parent>/lib. |
| `M3_LOGS_ROOT` | `[paths].logs_root` | Scheduled-task and service logs. Default: &lt;memory_root>/logs, else ~/.m3/logs. |
| `M3_MEMORY_ROOT` | `[paths].memory_root` | Master root: the engine, logs and models roots derive from it when their own keys are unset. The config root never does (M3_CONFIG_ROOT or ~/.m3/config locates it). |
| `M3_MODELS_ROOT` | `[paths].models_root` | GGUF weights m3 owns. Default: &lt;memory_root>/models, else ~/.m3/models. |

**Not read.** m3 reads one variable, `M3_CONFIG_ROOT`, and takes every root from `m3_config.toml` (the `paths.*` keys above). `m3 doctor` lists any of the other names still set, to delete, and the `m3 config set` that chooses each root. Set `M3_CONFIG_ROOT` only for a config root other than `~/.m3/config`, and then everywhere m3 runs: an agent's MCP server reads it from its registration's `env` block (for Claude Code, `~/.claude.json`), the chatlog hooks from the agent's process environment.

### Not settings

Read by m3 by design, and never a key in the file:

| Name | Why it stays an environment variable |
|---|---|
| `M3_CORE_RS_DISABLE` | retired as a user setting; tests use a fixture |
| `M3_DEBUG` | the diagnostic switch, read before config loads |
| `M3_DIFF_REF_BIN` | search_differential.py's own parameter |
| `M3_DIFF_REF_PYTHON` | search_differential.py's own parameter |
| `M3_DIFF_REF_REV` | search_differential.py's own parameter |
| `M3_DIFF_STORE` | search_differential.py's own parameter |
| `M3_HTTP_HOST` | in-process handoff; 2E makes it a parameter |
| `M3_HTTP_PATH` | in-process handoff; 2E makes it a parameter |
| `M3_HTTP_PORT` | in-process handoff; 2E makes it a parameter |
| `M3_HTTP_PUBLIC_HOST` | in-process handoff; 2E makes it a parameter |
| `M3_INSTALL_OXIDATION` | install_os.py's unattended answer to the native-core prompt |
| `M3_SKIP_MIGRATIONS` | test hook: skip schema migrations (memory/db.py:282) |
| `M3_STARGAZER` | release tooling token (gen_download_badges.py; as GITHUB_TOKEN) |
| `M3_TRACE_FILE` | setup-wizard debug breadcrumbs |
| `M3_TRANSPORT` | in-process handoff; 2E makes it a parameter |
| `M3_WIKI_DRIFT_PRECISION_FLOOR` | test plumbing: the drift judge live test (wiki/citation_drift.py:183) |
| `M3_WIKI_DRIFT_RECALL_FLOOR` | test plumbing: the drift judge live test (wiki/citation_drift.py:182) |
| `_M3_UTF8_REEXEC` | internal guard against re-executing twice for UTF-8 mode |

### Legacy store locations

A database path is a locator, not a setting, so `import-env` never moves these. m3 does not read them; `m3 doctor` and `m3 config import-env` name where one is set with its replacement (`--database PATH` or a `[stores.<name>]` table with `--store NAME`; `--chatlog-db PATH` for the chatlog).

| Name | What it locates |
|---|---|
| `AGENT_DB` | main: the core SQLite file, legacy spelling of M3_AGENT_DB |
| `CHATLOG_DB` | the chatlog SQLite file, legacy spelling of M3_CHATLOG_DB |
| `CHATLOG_DB_PATH` | the chatlog SQLite file, legacy spelling of M3_CHATLOG_DB_PATH |
| `M3_AGENT_DB` | main: the core SQLite file, build_kg_variant's alias |
| `M3_CHATLOG_DATABASE` | the chatlog SQLite file for the chatlog backfill and enrich scripts |
| `M3_CHATLOG_DB` | the process-wide chatlog SQLite file (D1) |
| `M3_CHATLOG_DB_PATH` | the process-wide chatlog SQLite file (D1) |
| `M3_DATABASE` | main: the core SQLite file (a named store outranks it, D3) |
| `M3_DB_PATH` | main: the core SQLite file, read by the session-start capture hook |
| `M3_DISPATCH_DB` | the notification-dispatch store |
| `M3_FILES_DB_PATH` | main: the files SQLite file (a named store outranks it) |
| `M3_MEMORY_DB` | main: the core SQLite file as files promotion records it |
| `M3_SYNC_DBS` | the SQLite files pg_sync replicates (a list) |

### Other programs' variables

m3 reads these, and never treats them as its own settings: `ANSICON`, `APPDATA`, `COMPUTERNAME`, `CUDA_PATH`, `FORCE_COLOR`, `GGML_LOG_LEVEL`, `GH_TOKEN`, `GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `HERMES_HOME`, `HOME`, `HOSTNAME`, `LOCALAPPDATA`, `LOGNAME`, `NO_COLOR`, `OLLAMA_MODELS`, `OneDrive`, `OneDriveCommercial`, `OneDriveConsumer`, `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, `OPENCODE_DATA_DIR`, `PATH`, `PATHEXT`, `PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE`, `PROGRAMDATA`, `PYTHONPATH`, `PYTHONUTF8`, `RUSTUP_HOME`, `SHELL`, `SSH_CONNECTION`, `SSH_TTY`, `SystemRoot`, `TERM_PROGRAM`, `USER`, `USERDOMAIN`, `USERNAME`, `USERPROFILE`, `VULKAN_SDK`, `WT_SESSION`, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`, `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`.

## Secrets: environment name to secrets file

**m3 never reads its own secrets from the environment** (or from `m3_config.toml`, which refuses one). Each resolves from the user-only secrets file (`[secrets] file`, default `<config root>/m3_secrets.toml`), then the OS keyring entry that file names, then the encrypted vault, except a bootstrap secret, which never comes from the vault ([details](CONFIG_REFERENCE.md#secrets)). Store one with `m3 secret set NAME`, which prompts for the value; never put a secret on a command line. `m3 config import-env` moves the ones still set in the places above, without showing their values. A scripted or CI install writes the secrets file rather than exporting variables for m3.

| Environment name | Stored as | Bootstrap |
|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_OS_MASTER_KEY` | `AGENT_OS_MASTER_KEY` in the secrets file | yes |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the secrets file | no |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the secrets file | no |
| `LM_API_TOKEN` | `LM_API_TOKEN` in the secrets file | no |
| `LM_STUDIO_API_KEY` | `LM_API_TOKEN` in the secrets file | no |
| `M3_AGENT_OS_SALT_HEX` | `M3_AGENT_OS_SALT_HEX` in the secrets file | yes |
| `M3_CDW_PG_URL` | `M3_CDW_PG_URL` in the secrets file | no |
| `PG_URL` | `M3_CDW_PG_URL` in the secrets file | no |
| `M3_CLOUD_AUTH_TOKEN` | `M3_CLOUD_AUTH_TOKEN` in the secrets file | no |
| `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN` | `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN` in the secrets file | no |
| `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN_SHA256` | `M3_EMBED_SERVER_TOKEN_SHA256` in the secrets file | no |
| `M3_PRIMARY_PG_URL` | `M3_PRIMARY_PG_URL` in the secrets file | yes |
| `M3_PG_URL` | `M3_PRIMARY_PG_URL` in the secrets file | yes |
| `M3_SERVE_TOKEN` | `M3_SERVE_TOKEN` in the secrets file | no |

## Retired: no effect

These names were settings that changed nothing, and are retired. Setting one has no effect; `m3 config show` names any that is set.

| Name | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `CHATLOG_MODE` | retired: no effect | only its presence is checked, to warn (chatlog_config.py:257) |
| `M3_CLOUD_MINIMIZATION_LEVEL` | retired: no effect | no consumer (memory/config.py:422) |
| `M3_CONFIDENCE_MODEL` | retired: no effect | no consumer (memory/config.py:252) |
| `M3_ENTITY_COALESCE_MAX_PAIRS` | retired: no effect | every caller passes 1000 (files_memory/entity_coalesce.py:69) |
| `M3_FILES_CORPUS` | retired: no effect | its reader has no production caller (files_memory/corpora.py:73) |
| `M3_FILES_DB_PROMPT_ON_FIRST_USE` | retired: no effect | no reader (memory/config.py:101) |
| `M3_FILES_DEDUP_LEAF_LIMIT` | retired: no effect | every caller passes 10000 (files_memory/dedup.py:55) |
| `M3_FILES_DEDUP_MAX_PAIRS` | retired: no effect | every caller passes 500 (files_memory/dedup.py:54) |
| `M3_FILES_DEDUP_THRESHOLD` | retired: no effect | every caller passes 0.92 (files_memory/dedup.py:53) |
| `M3_FILES_DEFAULT_SCOPE` | retired: no effect | no reader (files_memory/config.py:84) |
| `M3_FILES_EXTRACT_CONCURRENCY` | retired: no effect | no reader (files_memory/config.py:111) |
| `M3_FILES_EXTRACT_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | retired: no effect | no reader (files_memory/config.py:116) |
| `M3_FILES_PROMO_SUGGEST_THRESHOLD` | retired: no effect | every caller passes 0.30 (files_memory/promotability.py:43) |
| `M3_HOME` | retired: no effect | retired in 2026.10.18.0: each hook finds m3 from its own location |
| `M3_ROUTE_SHADOW_MODE` | retired: no effect | route shadow mode was retired in 2026.10.17.3: the native router is used when present |
| `M3_TRUST_AUTOTUNE` | retired: no effect | no consumer (memory/config.py:265) |
